description:
## Why

AGENTS.md is the policy anchor. Until this lands, every other sweep is editing under stale top-level policy. Do this first.

## What

### AGENTS.md edits

1. Line 35 ("Key design facts"): `Path building (RFC 4158 — cross-signed certs, multiple candidate issuers) is out of scope for v0.1.`
   → Replace with: `Path building (RFC 4158 — cross-signed certs, multiple candidate issuers) lives in \`pkix-path-builder\`. \`pkix-path\` itself is positional: chain[i+1] must be the issuer of chain[i].`

2. Lines 59–62 ("## v0.1 deliverable" section):
   ```
   ## v0.1 deliverable

   RSA-PKCS1v15 + P-256 signing, no NameConstraints, no revocation, configurable max depth.
   PKITS happy-path subset green. All unimplemented features have rustdoc `# Limitations` sections.
   ```
   → Replace section with:
   ```
   ## Status

   Crypto coverage, RFC compliance, and feature surfaces land incrementally.
   Per-crate `# Limitations` rustdoc sections describe what each crate's
   shipped code currently does and does not do. The driving goal is full
   RFC 5280 and adjacent-RFC coverage; no work is gated by a version
   milestone.

   PKITS (NIST) test corpus is the integration-test bar. See
   `pkix-difftest/baseline-pkits-analysis.md` for current state.
   ```

### CHANGELOG.md edits

Add a new top-of-file entry under an Unreleased / next-version section:

```
- **Policy:** Dropped v0.x milestone gating. The project drives to full RFC 5280
  and adjacent-RFC coverage; no features are gated by a version milestone.
  Per-crate `# Limitations` rustdoc sections describe current shipped behavior.
  See PKIX-agp7 for the sweep.
```

Do NOT rewrite historical entries.

## Acceptance

- [ ] AGENTS.md line 35 reflects pkix-path-builder reality.
- [ ] AGENTS.md no longer has `## v0.1 deliverable` section heading.
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md has the policy-shift entry, dated 2026-05-11.
- [ ] No other AGENTS.md or CHANGELOG sections touched.

## Out of scope (Category B, legitimate)

- The 'What this is' AGENTS.md section listing only 3 crates while we have 13 — separate hygiene issue, separate bead if anyone cares.
- Per-crate sweep — that's PKIX-agp7.2.
- Bead description sweep — that's PKIX-agp7.3.
title: AGENTS.md + CHANGELOG anchor: drop v0.1 deliverable section, kill path-building scope line
